purpose: Replace old Figure 8 and sensitivity evidence with the adopted chronological source-prefix protocol
source: Sealed chronological run; no original full-source landscape reuse
estimation_evaluation: Each fixed parameter variant refits the same source statistics; the other parameter remains adaptive. Coverage and TUWR tolerances are multiplied jointly; ARD remains only tie-breaking. Same held-out target suffix as the new main run.
ramp_validation: Original 3-fold source-zone validation within each 9-zone outer source set: sources[inner::3] validate, remaining 6 fit. Only records with issue<T0, label<T0, availability<=T0. Outer source width/TSC settings are held common as in the original threshold sensitivity design; conditional cost/coverage estimates exclude the 3 inner validation zones.
threshold_decision: Main tau remains 0.12. All 6 source-validation grid points are reported; no target-driven selection or new cutoff.
aggregation: Pool seeds with forecast/window denominators, then equal conditions. Threshold curves equal-average source validation conditions and outer folds; overlapping folds are not independent replicates.
inference: Estimation/screening sensitivity pointwise 95% paired bootstrap over the 10 outer zones, 10000 draws, seed 20260925. No multiplicity-adjusted confirmatory sensitivity claim.
immutability: No writes to sealed CHRONO, original data, manuscript, supplement or public repository. All artifacts remain in analysis_sensitivity.
